title: std::queue<T,Container>::~queue
summary: A destructor. Destructs the queue. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.
html:
~queue();

A destructor. Destructs the queue. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.

Complexity

Linear in the size of the queue.
